title: Bylaws.
bodyText:
(a) The incorporators or board of directors of a corporation shall adopt initial bylaws for the corporation.

(b) The bylaws of a corporation may contain any provision for managing the business and regulating the affairs of the corporation that is not inconsistent with law or the articles of incorporation.
bodyHtml:
[§414-36]  Bylaws.  (a)  The incorporators or board of directors of a corporation shall adopt initial bylaws for the corporation.

     (b)  The bylaws of a corporation may contain any provision for managing the business and regulating the affairs of the corporation that is not inconsistent with law or the articles of incorporation. [L 2000, c 244, pt of §1]
